venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Sunday 8/9.** Closed on Sundays — dark day, no report expected.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Sunday 8/9.** MOD KE, Chef JMS. Net $1,674 vs $1,448 target (+15.6%). Food $162, comps $22 (1.3%), 46 guests, ~$37 check avg. A decent Sunday that surpassed goal with good food sales. Slow first four hours (~$400), then the majority of sales came 9pm–midnight; a late-night pop kept beer/wine/seltzer service going until ~12:30-12:45 while closing down. Kitchen smooth — Jean Michael's dedication paying off. Favorite moment: Sunday regular Gabe brought in his dog Moose.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Sunday 8/9.** AM MJH; PM Carey & Chef Lucas. Net $11,027.09 vs $10,183 target (+8.3%). AM $1,461.32, PM $9,565.77, Garden/6A $3,077.64; food $2,445.10; comps $375.35 (3.40%); 175 guests (Tock). No events. Eventful AM (exploding cans, frozen tea containers, kid spills) but Felix kept spirits high. Super sleepy evening in the main room — under the ~200-guest standard, lots of cleaning tasks done and genuine guest moments. Garden busy start, died off ~8pm; first solo close went well. Kitchen slow, Marv cut early. Interesting dynamic: slammed 3-5:30pm, then a 6pm concert pulled the crowd and it never picked back up.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Sunday 8/9.** MOD Kyler/Seth, no chef. Net $3,974 vs $3,660 target (+8.6%). Beverage $3,864, food $110, comps $122.77 (almost all service recovery, still low), 114 guests (SevenRooms), $35 check avg. Service notes: 'Respectfully, what the fuck?' — busy for a Sunday. Balled out running inside and outside simultaneously — dual hospitality; quiet 8-10pm (for once a blessing) before a light resurgence. Kitchen temporarily offline. Top sellers: Golden Cobra, Worker's Comp, Paper Wasp/Rosalie (tie). Breakage: egg coupe, v-martini, N&N, DOF, SOF.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: Another warm night in the city
venues.narrative: **LA — Sunday 8/9.** MOD Joe + Josh + Oscar. Net $4,845 vs $4,918 target (-1.5%). Food $1,163, comps $44.40 (Javier of Howlin' Ray's, Brent and Picha, DNL), 124 guests. Steady Sunday: opened with 40 covers and a nice early walk-in push — first hour was the busiest (~$2k). Reservations concentrated 7-8:30pm filled the room; brief waitlist cleared quickly. Room stayed full to a smooth last call — a nice end to a busy weekend. Kitchen busy; lowboy being fixed tomorrow. Favorite moment: a guest brought sandwiches from the new Frank and Franks in Chinatown. (Report date typed 2028-08-09; matched by post time.)

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Sunday 8/9.** MOD Josh. Net $1,587.95 vs $2,739 target (-42.0%). Marquee bar sales $2,067.37; garden closed. Food $134.80; comps $54.90 + voids $15; 41 guests. Light Sunday — slow open, picked up an hour in; mainly date-night couples plus a few groups escaping the heat. Slow, steady grind with the team using downtime to reset the space. Went well: guest connection. Improve: closing SOPs. Favorite moment: a regular dropped off homemade BBQ for family meal.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Humid and hot, scattered storms through the day
venues.narrative: **MG — Sunday 8/9.** AM Sam & Lex; PM Justin & Marcus. Net $6,968 vs $6,000 target (+16.1%). Municipal Bar AM $3,148 / PM $3,268; Sun Club $0 (closed shortly after opening due to on-and-off rain); Hot Eye $563; food $3,488; comps $214; guests 107 AM + 62 PM (OpenTable). Quick morning start with hotel guests, pause 9-10am, then 9-10 tables going by noon on just one server — Jack, Matt, Aimee and Tia all stepped up, Chandler in early to catch up sidework. Evening slow and steady, cleared out by 10:30. Hot Eye quiet: usual 9pm bar crawl, small industry group from Common Thread at close. Kitchen steady; chai and mousse 86'd, back by next service. Favorite moment: a guest professed love to Catie over her hospitality — 'you know where to find me.'
